scout.attack: One complete physical fencing practice toward the right. From the ready stance shift weight backward and draw the short sword near the hip, drive hips and shoulders forward into one compact diagonal sword cut, follow through and recover to ready. Clear preparation, quick swing and full-body recovery. The sword is a solid rigid unlit metal object of constant length. A quiet physical rehearsal. Only the body, clothes and sword move; the empty background remains completely unchanged, with no motion lines, energy effects or sparks.
scout.hurt: One complete quick recoiling body gesture. From the ready stance, abruptly lean the head and shoulders backward, bend the knees and lower the hips while drawing the arms closer to the torso, then regain balance and return to the starting stance. The whole torso, hips, knees and head participate naturally, and hair and fabric follow through. Keep feet in the same small area and keep the same held weapon. Only the character moves. The surrounding empty background stays entirely unchanged and featureless throughout.

serin.name: 瑟琳
serin.description: An adult silver-haired woman wearing an ivory white and teal short robe with gold ornaments and tall boots, holding an unlit decorative short staff. Preserve the illustrated face, hair, outfit, proportions and physical prop.
serin.attack: One complete precise holy-bolt casting gesture toward the right. Keep the short staff in one hand, draw it back near the shoulder as hips turn, then extend the staff with a crisp full-body forward weight transfer to aim a light bolt, and recover to ready. Her head tracks the aim, shoulders and chest respond naturally, hair and robe follow. Draw only the character and staff, no beam, glow, projectile or particle; effects are independent game layers.
serin.cast: One complete practical greeting gesture. The woman holds the same unlit short staff steadily in one hand. Her free empty hand lifts naturally near her chest as her head inclines, then she extends the open hand toward the right as if indicating the direction to another person. Fingers naturally spread. Her shoulders, chest and hips coordinate with the reaching hand, then she lowers the hand and returns to the initial stance. Silver hair and teal fabric follow her movement. Only physical body movement, completely flat unlit background. The staff stays physically unchanged and unlit for the entire sequence. No energy is produced.
